title: A Phantomatic Nightshift - Free Game
author: MTIndieDev
selftext:
Welcome to A Phantomatic Nightshift, where the dead have paperwork and you have a shift to finish.



A short first-person paranormal comedy about bureaucracy, bad decisions, and ghosts who desperately need a hobby.

  
AI Usage: Images, Banners, Textures, Voice Lines (ChatGPT Plus and Speechma)



🆕📢Version 4 Fixes & Updates:



\-Prevented ghost clutter the Crossing Office by moving the surgeon in the lobby room



\-Added splash intro



\-Added CRT material to the Lobby TV



\-Made the non-quest interactables more visible



\-Added Crossed names on the Crossing List after each Phantom Pass



\-Added Lobby Ticket No. incrementation after each Phantom pass 



\-Changed the portal material due to eye comfort



\-Added intractability to the rules poster. Press E to better see the rules poster



\-Added Main Menu button functionality in the credits level



\-Added on-level Radio Ghost



\-Enabled VSync to prevent screen tear



🆕📢Version 3 Fixes & Updates:



\-Camera twitching and sudden rotation



\-Finished the highlighting system for interactable objects



\-Changed the menu background



\-Added a Main Menu button in the credits level



\-Fixed the prompts appearing after objects are no longer interactable



\-Changed some wall and ground textures to ones more decent



\-Fixed several aesthetic bugs



\-fixed audio lined playing on top of one another



\-Shortened the Exorcism prayer



\-Quest Widget fades with the ending fade
